correctness.rationale: For every integer N≥6, 0≤k≤N, and 1≤d≤floor((N−1)/2), the distance graph is N/gcd(N,d) cycles; its N edges and triple-edge motif counts are enumerated exactly. The raw first three moments and finite-population identity p3−3p4+3p5−p6=(k)3(N−k)3/(N)6 prove the formula. Exact rational enumeration of every subset through N=12 passed 827 comparisons in 274 cases, while the universal proof does not rely on enumeration.

value.rationale: A natural distance-resolved autocorrelation test under a fixed-count randomization null exhibits universal first and second moments, yet precisely one shift-order-three anomaly in the third centered moment. At balanced weight it reverses skewness sign and supplies an exact arithmetic diagnostic that cannot be derived from second moments. This is a motivated structural classification, not an arbitrary numerical slice.
